logline: A dark loading dock on W 30th St. Ice steaming, a rich man soaked to the elbows, and a collector in a cheap tan coat.

shots.move: slow crane down from the dark loft windows
shots.framing: W 30th St in the brownout: no streetlights, the ice truck's headlights the only light
shots.blocking: Men hand ice blocks down a chain into the vault
beats: Steam rises off the ice in the headlights
shots.notes: audio: dripping; a compressor not running (silence); a distant siren | lighting: headlights only; deep shadow | film: grain heavy; lifted blacks

shots.framing: Nick in a dinner jacket, bow tie loose, sleeves rolled, lifting ice like a nailer
shots.blocking: Teddy steps into the headlight beam from the street

shots.framing: Profile, the truck lights between them
shots.blocking: Yiannis hands Teddy an envelope without looking at either man

shots.framing: Nick's face, the steam behind him
beats: l6: 'I own the Corwin. On paper.'

shots.blocking: He turns and walks back into the dark

shots.framing: Nick alone in the headlights, water dripping off his cuffs
